fusions.name: Rolled Gazette
fusions.desc: Throws a rolled gazette into the first enemy it meets for 8 damage. Holds 3 charges, and each kill fetches one back.

fusions.name: Charter of the Pack
fusions.desc: Howls a signed charter aloud, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. On a hit, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Note in the Jaws
fusions.desc: Sends a hound with a written remedy in its jaws to the ally who needs it most, restoring 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Faithful Copy
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded hound folded from your own pages that fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
